snippet.title: Better than Adventure! 8.0 Release Trailer (Minecraft Beta 1.7.3 mod)
snippet.description:
Better than Adventure! 8.0 brings an overhauled Nether dimension, with a bounty of new biomes to explore, new items to collect, and more! Available now at betterthanadventure.net!

Trailer produced by @thaboar.

== How to install ==
Download links and install instructions can be found at www.betterthanadventure.net.

== About the mod ==
Better than Adventure, or 'BTA' is an extensive mod for Minecraft Beta 1.7.3, bringing out regular updates attempting to create a more "finalized" version of beta Minecraft while also maintaining the look and feel of the game pre-Adventure Update.
